passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report. In addition to historical information, this discussion and analysis contains forward‑looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward‑looking statements as a result of certain factors. We discuss factors that we believe could cause or contribute to these differences below and elsewhere in this report, including those set forth under “Part I—Item 1A—Risk Factors” and under “Forward‑Looking Statements and Market Data” in this Annual Report. A discussion of the Company’s financial condition and results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 can be found in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Non-GAAP Financial Measures We provide certain financial measures that are not defined under accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“GAAP”), commonly referred to as non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted Operating Expenses, Adjusted Income (Loss) from Operations, Adjusted Net Income (Loss), Adjusted Earnings Per Share, Free Cash Flow and certain other non-GAAP measures, each of which include adjustments to GAAP figures. These non-GAAP measures are intended to provide additional information on our operating performance. Adjustments to our GAAP figures exclude, as applicable, non-cash items such as share-based compensation, depreciation and amortization. Certain other special items or substantive events may also be included in the non-GAAP adjustments periodically when their magnitude is significant within the periods incurred. Non-GAAP adjustments are tax effected to the extent there is US GAAP current tax effect. The Company currently records a valuation allowance on its net deferred tax assets, so there is no net impact recorded for deferred tax effects in our tax expense. We maintain an established non-GAAP policy that guides the determination of what items may be excluded in non-GAAP financial measures. We believe that these non-GAAP measures, when considered together with the GAAP figures, can enhance an overall understanding of our operating performance. The non-GAAP financial measures are included with the intent of providing investors with a more complete understanding of our historical and expected financial results and trends and to facilitate comparisons between periods and with respect to projected information. In addition, these non-GAAP financial measures are among the indicators BeOne’s management uses for planning and forecasting purposes and measuring our performance. These non-GAAP financial measures should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for, or superior to, GAAP financial measures. credit_strengths.text: Revenue has compounded rapidly across the last three fiscal years, and operating income swung from a loss to a solid profit, lifting the operating margin above the health care sector median. This commercial ramp is the core credit positive, though the margin gap to peers still leaves room for improvement.

Operating cash flow turned strongly positive and now covers capital expenditure several times over, producing free cash flow that exceeds total debt. Liquidity is ample, with a current ratio well above the sector median and cash exceeding debt, so the balance sheet carries net cash.

key_risks.text: The risk factors highlight that the issuer has limited experience launching and marketing internally developed and in-licensed medicines, and faces substantial competition that could erode commercial traction. If marketing or reimbursement falters, revenue growth and cash generation may reverse, weakening the improving credit profile.

Debt is modest but not zero, comprising long-term borrowings including current maturities plus short-term borrowings. Interest expense is a real cash cost, and although coverage is comfortable, the debt stack carries refinancing and rate risk that could pressure free cash flow if operating performance softens.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage sits comfortably above the sector median, and free cash flow to debt is strong, indicating ample capacity to service obligations from internally generated funds. The net cash position further reduces refinancing pressure, though coverage remains sensitive to any margin reversal.

Gross leverage is below the sector median and net leverage is negative, reflecting cash exceeding debt. With no material near-term maturities disclosed, the debt profile appears manageable, but the absence of a detailed maturity schedule limits visibility on refinancing timing and could mask concentration risk.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is underpinned by a net cash balance sheet, improving profitability, and robust free cash flow that comfortably covers debt. The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, and leverage sits well below the health care sector median, supporting a stable credit trajectory.

Forward-looking, the key judgement is whether the commercial ramp sustains. Competitive and reimbursement risks could stall revenue growth, while the debt stack and interest burden remain manageable but not immaterial. We view the outlook as stable, contingent on continued cash generation and disciplined capital allocation.

credit_strengths.text: 過去三個財政年度收入快速複合增長，經營利潤由虧損轉為穩健盈利，帶動經營利潤率升至醫療保健行業中位數以上。此商業化爬坡是核心信用正面因素，儘管與同業的利潤率差距仍有改善空間。
經營現金流強勁轉正，現時足以覆蓋資本開支數倍，產生的自由現金流超過總債務。流動性充裕，流動比率遠高於行業中位數，且現金超過債務，故資產負債表持有淨現金。

key_risks.text: 風險因素凸顯發行人於推出及營銷自主研發及授權引進藥物的經驗有限，並面臨激烈競爭，可能侵蝕商業化動力。若營銷或報銷受阻，收入增長及現金產生可能逆轉，削弱正在改善的信用狀況。
債務規模適度但非零，包括長期借款（含流動部分）加短期借款。利息開支為實際現金成本，儘管覆蓋率舒適，債務結構仍帶來再融資及利率風險，若經營表現轉弱，可能對自由現金流構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率舒適地高於行業中位數，自由現金流對債務比率強勁，顯示有充裕能力以內部產生資金償付債務。淨現金狀況進一步降低再融資壓力，惟覆蓋率對任何利潤率逆轉仍敏感。
總槓桿低於行業中位數，淨槓桿為負，反映現金超過債務。所披露資料顯示並無重大近期到期債務，債務狀況似乎可控，但缺乏詳細到期時間表限制了對再融資時間的能見度，並可能掩蓋集中度風險。

overall_credit_view.text: 信用狀況受淨現金資產負債表、盈利能力改善及穩健自由現金流（足以舒適覆蓋債務）支撐。指示性財務風險狀況為極低，槓桿遠低於醫療保健行業中位數，支持穩定的信用軌跡。
前瞻而言，關鍵判斷在於商業化爬坡能否持續。競爭及報銷風險可能令收入增長停滯，而債務結構及利息負擔仍屬可控但非微不足道。我們認為展望穩定，取決於持續現金產生及紀律性資本配置。
